llm.summary: This Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning skill is purpose-aligned, scoped, and does not show hidden execution, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill references persistent class-workspace and file capabilities, but the declared reads and writes are narrow, teacher-facing, and tied to lesson planning; sensitive student data is limited to aliases or seat numbers and real names/contact details are prohibited.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is self-contained Markdown and JSON with no executable scripts, package installation steps, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within lesson-planning, classroom safety, privacy, and crisis-referral boundaries; routing to other skills is disclosed and there are explicit limits against acting as the teacher or providing full lab procedures.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It can use long-term class records when the platform provides memory, but it exposes view/correct/delete/pause/share/export controls and writes only pending lesson-plan entries for teacher confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill is clearly framed as a teacher-facing chemistry lesson planner for Chinese middle and high school contexts, focused on lesson drafts, triple-representation pedagogy, lesson compression, and transition lessons.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this for Chinese-language chemistry teachers working in the Mainland China K12 curriculum context. Operators outside that locale should localize curriculum assumptions, emergency contacts, and data-consent rules before using it with students.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Chinese language and Mainland China K12 locale are not hidden or purpose-mismatched: platform-conventions.md explicitly scopes the repository to Mainland China's Chinese K12 context, and SKILL.md metadata, curriculum references, crisis-localization guidance, and grade-band rules align with that disclosed deployment.
